name: Finite trajectory loops
description: Exercise 2.122: prove every state trajectory of a finite system loops within TZ[0, #SZ]. Canonical proof lives in WymoreCore.

elements.text: If Z is finite, f in ITZ, and x in SZ, then there exist t1, t2 in TZ[0, #SZ] with t1 < t2 and STZ(f, x)(t1) = STZ(f, x)(t2).
